faq.a: Abdulwahid is associated with the Arabic form عَبْدُ الْوَاحِد, whose core sense is abdulwahid; servant of the one.

faq.q: What is the origin of Abdulwahid?
faq.a: Abdulwahid is associated with Arabic. Abdulwahid is Arabic عَبْدُ الْوَاحِد (ʿAbd al-Wāḥid), meaning 'servant of the One'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الْوَاحِد is Arabic.
Abdulwahid can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdulwahid should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd al-Wāḥid is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.
